## Summary
What changes, and which subproject is affected?

## Validation
- [ ] Relevant subproject tests and build checks completed.
- [ ] Existing user-facing behavior considered.
- [ ] New external tools, credentials and network permissions reviewed.
- [ ] No tokens, private reports, `.env` files or user data committed.
- [ ] Rollback instructions provided below.

## Rollback
How can this change be reverted without destroying saved scan results or application state?
